data

object

The data object containing the resource type and attributes for the facet info response.

attributes

object

Attributes of the facet info response, containing the facet result data.

result

object

The facet query result containing discrete value counts or a numeric range for the requested facet.

range

object

The numeric range of a facet attribute, representing the minimum and maximum observed values.

The maximum observed value for the numeric facet attribute. Null when no records match.

values

[object]

List of discrete facet values with their occurrence counts.

count

int64

The number of records that have this facet value.

value

string

The facet value (for example, a browser name or country code).

id

string

Unique identifier for the facet info response resource.

type [required]

enum

Facet info resource type. Allowed enum values: users_facet_info,accounts_facet_info

default: users_facet_info

data

object

object

string

string

object
